root.label: Arncliffe home invasion and sexual assault

events.label: Arncliffe home invasion and sexual assault

slots.name: victim age
slots.sentence: Officers were told a group of men forced entry into the home and threatened a 31-year-old woman with a knife before sexually assaulting her and stealing money.

slots.name: incident time
slots.sentence: New South Wales police were called to a home invasion in Arncliffe at about midnight on Tuesday morning.

slots.name: injury status
slots.sentence: The woman, who did not know the men, was taken to hospital with “minor” physical injuries, police said on Friday.
